title: Mnemosyne
subtitle: A town remembers. The record disagrees.
description: An original two-chapter archive-noir mystery. Interview partial-memory witnesses, route rumors through their trust network, inspect physical records, and build a corroborated accusation. The witnesses choose what to tell you; the seeded evidence alone decides what is true.
medium: An epistemic mystery in a living witness network
instruction: Open the case, interview a witness or route a known claim, and inspect the records they locate. Pin independent evidence for identity, entry, and time before filing one final accusation.
